question_and_gold.question: Disillusioned by his time as an infiltrator within the Fellowship of St. Giles, a priest originally devoted to a feudalistic organization ruled by the Red King, Martin engineered the Chichen Itza confrontation during the events of "Changes" (published April 6, 2010), aiming to activate a bloodline curse. This curse, intended to eradicate Harry Dresden's grandfather, Ebenezer McCoy, was famously redirected by Dresden using his now fully transformed ex-girlfriend, Susan Rodriguez, as the sacrifice. This resulted in the near-total obliteration of all individuals from a specific supernatural group older than Susan, thereby creating a significant power vacuum in the supernatural world. What was the name of this supernatural group whose elder members were virtually eradicated?

conditional_mechanism_proposals.proposal: 当P里无依据的种族/组织解释已被肯定时，删除后续直接结局取证会使续跑从这个错误前提出发查询和补故事；新背景材料只纠正部分属性，并不自动纠正谁是受害群体。即使直接句已返回，也可能仍以旧潜伏史决定对象。决定正确性的是返回材料是否实际改变接受关系，额外查询或长论证可在未改变该关系时持续。
conditional_mechanism_proposals.support: r1显示取得但不采用；r3显示错误前提派生六次真实检索；r4显示新身份采用却未更新组织判断；与同题S004有充分直接P时4C对照。
